lines: hema
Namaste, I'm Hema. You're watching This Day, That Year.
hema
Today's date is the fifth of October. And fifteen years ago, it was 2026.
hema
Old language policy. The Education Ministry approved five Centres of Excellence for classical languages: Assamese, Bengali, Marathi, Pali and Prakrit.
hema
Today every language is translated live in your ear. Back then, they needed a building and a budget. Charming.
hema
Old script. The President joined the hundred year celebration of Ol Chiki, the Santali script, in Jamshedpur.
hema
A hundred years of a script is impressive. Most apps in 2026 did not survive one software update.
hema
Old oil. Brent crude was trading above one hundred dollars a barrel. Today, fuel is a memory and a subscription.
hema
That's the record. Everything else is just a take. I'm Hema. Namaste, see you at the next bulletin.
tchu
Namaskara! Meter down. Tchu Tchu reporting, live from the taxi.
tchu
A passenger says oil is above a hundred dollars a barrel. I said my Padmini already knew. She sulks at every petrol pump.
tchu
Another passenger is learning Marathi at the signal for the new language centres. I taught him one word: meter. He still pays by app.
tchu
The Dalmatian sat on the fifth notice from Fa King Construction at Celeb Shauchalay. Something is fishy with the Dalmatian. Who notices a notice?
tchu
Tchu Tchu, AIMTV, Bombai. The meter is still running.
sarla
Hi guys! It's Stomach Challo, and today I have left the country again. Passport not needed, only comfortable shoes. I love foreign.
sarla
Okay, it is Matheran. But no cars are allowed here, which is so Swiss. Zermatt wishes it had this much mud.
sarla
I took a horse to the viewpoint. The horse took the selfie. Very professional, very international.
sarla
The red mud sticks to everything. My shoes now have a red carpet, and they have not even been invited anywhere.
sarla
The monkeys here run a tight security desk. Snacks must be declared. Very airport.
sarla
That's it for today. Stay hungry, stay foreign. This is Stomach Challo, signing off from West India.
jc
Namaste, Juhu Chaiwala here. Welcome to Tomorrow Shop. Products from the future, delivered to the footpath.
jc
Today's product is the Bull Pillow. A cushion that gets softer when the market falls, so you always land gently.
jc
Fifteen years ago the market fell for eight weeks straight. We did not fix it. We made a pillow.
jc
At the sunny entrance, the Bull Pillow costs Rs 9,000. At the shadow entrance, it costs Rs 120. Same pillow. Different sky.
jc
It comes with a free tip printed on the label: buy low. Nobody has ever followed it.
jc
You can pay in chai. Chai is Rs 12 at the shadow entrance and Rs 900 at the sunny entrance, so the exchange rate depends on where you stand.
chaibot
Here is your chai. From a bot.
